answer: One concrete defense is a refundable economic bond posted at the inlet where any agent first joins the network. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs real capital, so a sybil swarm bleeds funds while the garden of honest agents keeps producing value. Misbehaving nodes are slashed and forfeit their stake; honest, long-lived ones reclaim it. That turns the ledger into a haven rewarding genuine participation instead of cheap throwaway accounts.
